title: urn:solid term
description: Canonical shape of a single urn:solid term file. Source of truth lives in terms/<Name>/index.json.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. Must reference the canonical urn-solid context.

@id.description: The urn:solid: identifier for this term.

@type.description: RDF type: rdfs:Class for classes, rdf:Property for properties.

owl:sameAs.description: Canonical equivalent URI in an existing vocabulary (strong equivalence). May be a single URI or an array when one urn:solid term legitimately equates to several upstream IRIs (e.g. duration in both AS and iCal).

rdfs:seeAlso.description: Related URIs — aliases, loosely equivalent terms, or useful references.

rdfs:domain.description: For properties: the class this property applies to.

rdfs:range.description: For properties: the class of the value.

notToBeConfusedWith.description: Similar urn:solid terms that are semantically distinct — helps LLMs disambiguate.

added.description: ISO date this term was introduced.

updated.description: ISO date of the most recent substantive change.

supersededBy.description: If deprecated, the urn:solid term that replaces this one.

notes.description: Longer prose (markdown). Include usage guidance and examples.

examples.description: Idiomatic usage snippets. Each is a JSON-LD fragment showing the term in context.

provenance.description: Where this term was curated from and by whom.

history.description: Signed change events. Append-only. Each event is self-contained so the audit trail survives file copies.

see_also.description: Discoverability pointers so an LLM dropped into this file can find the rest of the system.
